description: This file implements an API client class for interacting with a backend server in a Flutter project, including authentication, CRUD operations for books, categories, users, analytics, and storage presigning, with JWT token handling and refresh logic.

classes.name: ApiClient
classes.description: A flexible client for backend API communication, supporting JWT bearer tokens, token refresh, and error handling.

methods.name: apiBase
methods.description: Getter to determine the base URL for API requests, with environment variable fallback.

methods.name: onForceLogout
methods.description: Setter for a callback invoked when the user must be logged out forcibly, e.g., on token expiry.

methods.name: _request
methods.description: Core method for making HTTP requests with support for retrying on token refresh.

methods.name: _tryRefresh
methods.description: Attempts to refresh the access token using the refresh token.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Authenticates user with email and password, stores tokens and user info.

methods.name: loginGoogle
methods.description: Authenticates user via Google ID token, stores tokens and user info.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Clears session tokens and user info.

methods.name: isLoggedIn
methods.description: Checks if the user currently has a valid access token.

methods.name: listBooks
methods.description: Retrieves a list of books with optional search, pagination, and filtering.

methods.name: createBook
methods.description: Creates a new book record with specified fields.

methods.name: updateBook
methods.description: Updates an existing book by ID with specified fields.

methods.name: listCategories
methods.description: Retrieves a list of categories with optional search and pagination.

methods.name: createCategory
methods.description: Creates a new category with specified fields.

methods.name: updateCategory
methods.description: Updates an existing category by ID.

methods.name: listUsers
methods.description: Retrieves a list of users (admin, read-only).

methods.name: getPresignedUploadUrl
methods.description: Obtains a presigned URL for uploading files to storage.
